description: Create an invoice in AbaNinja as a DRAFT. It is not sent — sending, dunning and cancelling are deliberately not exposed here; do those in AbaNinja. Requires customer_uuid and at least one position (title + single_price). The total is computed by AbaNinja via its own /calculate endpoint and that figure is what gets submitted — this tool does no VAT or rounding arithmetic of its own, because a self-computed total that is one rappen out is a wrong document. Payment instructions come from the tenant's default bank account unless bank_account_uuid is given.

address_uuid.description: Overrides the customer's primary address, e.g. for a second location.

bank_account_uuid.description: Defaults to the account marked default.

customer_number.description: Only used as a fallback when no address can be found for the customer — AbaNinja then accepts the customer number on its own.

customer_uuid.description: AbaNinja customer uuid from get_abaninja_customer — a company OR a private person. Which of the two it is is looked up, not asked, and so is the customer's address: AbaNinja requires an address uuid next to the customer uuid.

payment_reference.description: Payment reference for the payment instructions

person_uuid.description: For a company: the contact person inside it. For a private person: that person, if it differs from customer_uuid.

positions.description: Line items. Each needs title and single_price; quantity defaults to 1.

description.description: Description of the line item; for product positions replaces title and text

product_uuid.description: AbaNinja uuid of a product for a product position

text.description: Additional text of the line item

vat_uuid.description: AbaNinja uuid of the VAT rate to apply

prices_include_vat.description: Whether position prices include VAT (default false)

name: create_abaninja_invoice
